supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: significant lateral extension beyond the outer eye corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between a pale, depigmented muzzle and dark, high-intensity periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with visible exposure of the lower lip margin

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: extensive irregular depigmentation and mottling visible across the lower muzzle and chin
other_distinctive_markers: presence of a thin vegetative stick or tool held in the mouth
